search.title: Search · Tony Shopping
search.noQuery: No query yet. Start from the home page.
search.reportTpl: Found {total} matches — {high} highly similar and {sim} similar. Fastest in Korea is {fastestStore} ({fastestEta}); the lowest final price is from {cheapestStore} at {cheapestPrice}. Considering review trust, I recommend {bestStore} — {bestName}.
search.warn1: Suspiciously low prices may indicate authenticity or shipping risks.
search.warn2: Overseas items may incur customs and delivery delays — verify final price.
search.warn3: New sellers with fewer than 100 reviews may be less reliable.
search.warn4: Items unclaimed for over 24 months may not be refundable.
search.empty: No items match the selected store.

chat.title: Tony · AI shopping assistant
chat.greet: Hi, I'm Tony. If the result isn't quite right or you want to narrow it down, just ask — by price, color, country, or shipping.

intent.cheap: Sorted by lowest final price. Starting from {min} incl. shipping.
intent.fast: Sorted by fastest shipping. The fastest is {eta}.
intent.authentic: Showing items with the highest authenticity score first.
intent.review: Sorted by most reviews. The top item has {n} reviews.
intent.vn: Filtered to items available in Vietnam — Shopee and Lazada dominate.
intent.fallback: Could you be more specific? e.g., "under $80 in black", "fast shipping in Korea", "most reviews".
